name: Possession Game
summary: Patient circulation, high lines, and central overloads.
managerHint: Managers who keep the ball and wait for gaps.
inPossession: Short combinations, width from fullbacks, late midfield runs.
outOfPossession: Compact mid-block; press triggers on backwards passes.
tips: Don't force verticals into a set defensive line.
Use AMF as a link, not a permanent second CF.

name: Quick Counter
summary: Win the ball and attack space before the opponent resets.
inPossession: First pass forward; runners beyond the ball.
tips: Keep one midfielder as a safety valve.
Don't spam long balls every turnover.

name: Long Ball Counter
summary: Bypass midfield with early diagonals into runners.
managerHint: Direct managers with pacey front lines.
inPossession: Early switch or channel ball into CF/SS.
tips: Target man + runner pairing works best.

name: Out Wide
summary: Stretch the pitch; create cutbacks and far-post headers.
outOfPossession: Trap inside; force play toward your strong wing.
tips: Don't cross every attack — recycle once.

name: Overload
summary: Flood one half-space and create numerical superiority.
managerHint: Modern overload instructions from v6 Game Plan tools.
inPossession: Pull markers with decoy runs; third-man arrives late.
outOfPossession: Rest defence stays compact on the weak side.
tips: Pair with Fluid Formations when available.
Don't leave CB isolated vs Quick Counter.

name: Short Passer (build emphasis)
summary: Editorial label for sides that refuse low-percentage switches.
inPossession: Triangles; GK as extra passer under pressure.

name: Defensive
summary: Low risk, deep lines, and selective counters.
inPossession: Few touches in midfield; clear channels.
outOfPossession: Two banks of four/five; deny half-spaces.
tips: Have one outlet who can hold.

name: Anchorman Midfield Focus
summary: Protect the box with a dedicated sitting midfielder.
managerHint: Any style that needs a destroyer screen.
tips: Don't ask Anchorman to join every attack.

name: Link-Up Play Emphasis
summary: Use dual Link-Up partners to create free men.
managerHint: Managers supporting Conte-style dual link patterns.
inPossession: Trigger Link-Up then attack the vacated lane.
outOfPossession: Recover shape quickly after the combination.
tips: Practice the trigger in training matches.
Don't spam if the first pass is covered.
